lines.text: David asks God to hurry and help him, and prays that those who seek his life will be ashamed.
David calls himself poor and needy, and says God is his help and his deliverer.
The writer calls God his rock and his fortress, and says he has leaned on God since his wedding.
The writer asks God not to discard him in old age, while his enemies say God has forsaken him.
The writer says he will praise God with the harp and the lyre for His wealth.
